title: Raiders at {other}
Hold {other}
The domain under attack
summary: Raiders gather to fall on {other}, {distance} to the {direction}. Hold the village in his lordship's name.
{other} has few guards and the raiders know it. Stand with the village and beat them off.
Ride to {other} and break the raiders before they burn it.
offer: Word from {other}: raiders, more than the village can hold. Go now, {distance} {direction}, and hold it.
His lordship's people at {other} look to this house. Be there when the raiders come.
Raiders will hit {other}. I want them broken on its fences, and I want you there to do it.
complete: {other} stands, and the raiders lie in its fields. That is a deed the court will hear of.
You held {other}. His lordship will remember this when he names his knights.
The raiders are broken and {other} is whole. A knight's deed.
